name: Registered Contract
definition: Contract registered for regulatory purpose by a registration agent for the journaling of payments made against the contract.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the registered contract.

DeliveryDate.name: Delivery Date
DeliveryDate.definition: Provides the date for the delivery of the registered contract.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Priority requested for the registered contract.

RegistrationDate.name: Registration Date
RegistrationDate.definition: Provides the date for the registration of the registered contract.

ClosureDate.name: Closure Date
ClosureDate.definition: Date of closure of the contract.

SubmissionDate.name: Submission Date
SubmissionDate.definition: Provides the date for the submission of the registered contract.

DeliveryMethod.name: Delivery Method
DeliveryMethod.definition: Provides the communication method for the delivery of the registered contract.

SubmissionMethod.name: Submission Method
SubmissionMethod.definition: Provides the communication method for the submission of the registered contract.

Certificate.name: Certificate
Certificate.definition: Certificate against which all transactions in the scope of the regulatory requirements are registered.

ContractBalance.name: Contract Balance
ContractBalance.definition: Contract balance on date of contract registration.

ReportingParty.name: Reporting Party
ReportingParty.definition: Party which must register the contract for regulatory reporting reasons.

RegistrationAgent.name: Registration Agent
RegistrationAgent.definition: Agent which is in charge of the registration of the contract.

ReceivingParty.name: Receiving Party
ReceivingParty.definition: Party which receives support information about the registered contract.

ClosureReason.name: Closure Reason
ClosureReason.definition: Reason of closure of the contract.

PaymentScheduleType.name: Payment Schedule Type
PaymentScheduleType.definition: Type of the payment schedule provided in the contract.

SendingParty.name: Sending Party
SendingParty.definition: Party which sends support information about the registered contract.

RelatedPayment.name: Related Payment
RelatedPayment.definition: Provides the payment related of the registered contract.

Attachment.name: Attachment
Attachment.definition: Documents provided as attachments to the registered contract.
